title: 食品栄養学
subtitle: Food and Nutrition
teachers:
NOMURA Kazuki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Learn about various nutrients in food and their functionality. Learn about the nutrition, function and safety of functional foods, such as functional label foods, foods for specific health use, nutritional functional foods, supplements, and general foods.
advice:
This is a basic course on food and nutrition. We will cover the following topics:

1. Food composition table
2. Changes in nutrition composition
3. Oxidation and degradation of foods
4. Nutritional functional foods
5. Functional indication foods

Students should be have completed “Introduction to Bioengineering” and “Microbiology” courses.
Students are required to actively participate in class.
requiredKnowledge: Requires completion of “Introduction to Bioengineering” and “Microbiology” courses.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is a basic course on food and nutrition. We will cover the following topics:

1. Food composition table
2. Changes in nutrition composition
3. Oxidation and degradation of foods
4. Nutritional functional foods
5. Functional indication foods

Students should be have completed “Introduction to Bioengineering” and “Microbiology” courses.
Students are required to actively participate in class.
